feature.name: User Onboarding
feature.description: Onboarding flow for new users to collect initial preferences and information. Shows after user registration and email verification but before first login. Displays a resume analysis progress banner to simulate processing during the flow.

component.name: OnboardingPage
component.description: Multi-step onboarding form with 4 questions about user experience and goals

props.prop: Uses context and navigation hooks internally

features.feature: Header integration with onboarding title display
Resume analysis banner displayed above questions for all users
Banner shows spinner and processing message during onboarding
On last step, banner transitions to completed state after 3-7 seconds (random)
Completed banner shows checkmark and completion message
Arrow navigation (left/right) instead of text buttons
Left arrow hidden on first step
Radio button selection for each question
Validation to ensure all questions are answered
API integration to save responses and mark onboarding complete

question.text: How many years of work experience do you have?
Are you currently looking for a job?
Which field best describes your background?
What's your goal with this resume?

endpoint.description: Complete user onboarding by saving responses (resume processing moved to email confirmation)

field.name: responses
field.description: Object containing all onboarding question responses

field.name: user
field.description: Updated user object with onboarding completed

integration.description: Updates user data in context after successful onboarding completion

navigation.redirect: Redirects based on priority: redirect param > default refine

priority.level1: redirect URL parameter or redirectUrl prop

usage.scenario: Landing page upload → /temp-upload (file saved) → /onboarding?temp_file_id=xxx → useEffect claims file via /resume/claim-temp-file → task starts processing → user completes onboarding → /refine

temp_file_claiming.trigger: useEffect runs on page load if temp_file_id present

backend_actions.action: Validates temp file exists and not expired

authentication.note: All users are always authenticated (even unregistered users with is_registered=False)
authentication.behavior: Always saves onboarding responses to backend via API for all users

features.feature: Displays onboarding title instead of steps

analysisBanner.description: Visual banner showing resume analysis progress
analysisBanner.position: Above question card in main content area

styling.layout: Flex row with icon and text
